7772.title: Provider plan metadata ignores profile plan fields
7772.rootCauseOneLine: BB derives plan metadata only from SDK initialization subscriptionType; refreshed local profile plan fields are ignored when the SDK account stays stale.
7772.proposedFix: First verify live SDK cache provenance and decide the authoritative plan signal; do not override SDK metadata with undocumented profile fields without that decision.
7772.caveats: Two clean provider-boundary runs use stubbed SDK account/usage probes and real temporary profile files. Live downgrade, CLI cache provenance, and daily refresh remain unverified. Complete test is inline in the report; raw artifacts stay outside the public repository.
